paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na muh ne in; laibuzial ne inla, Israel inkote kiang ah thu va gen in," achi hi.
Huchi in ka kam ka ka a, laibuzial ahon nesakta hi.
Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, ka hon piak hiai laibuzial in na gil ah vahsak inla, hiai in na gilsung hihdim in," achi hi. Huchi in ka neta a, akhumdan ka kam ah khuaizu bang ahi hi.
Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa kuan inla, Israel inkote kiang ah ka thute zang in va gen in.
Pau tuam leh pau haksate kiang a sawl na hi kei a, Israel inkote kiang a sawl na hi zaw a;
nam pau tuam leh pau haksa athu uh na theihtheihlouhte kiang a sawl na hi kei hi. Akiang ua nang ka hon sawl in pel lou in na thu angaikhe mahmah ding uh.
Himahleh Israel inkote'n ahon ngaikhe kei ding ua, kei ahon ngaikhe kei ding uh, Israel inkote tengteng taltangtak leh lungtang genhak mahmah ahi uhi.
Huan ngai in, na mai amau mai lak ah khauhsak in, na taltang leng amau taltang sang a takzaw in ka bawl hi.
Suang tak mahmah, meisuang sang a takzaw in na tal ka bawl a, lau ke'nla, amit hah uah lunglel sam ke'n, helhat inkuan himah le uh," achi hi.
Huai lou leng ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na kiang a ka thugen ding tengteng na bil in ngaikhia inla, na lungtang ah khum in.
Kuan inla, na chipih saltangte kiang va tung inla; angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, 'Hichibang Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,' chi in gen inla, hilh in," achi hi.
Huchi in kha in ahon domkangta a, amun a kipan TOUPA thupina adinkhiak lai in, ka nunglam ah zinling thawm ka za hi.
Huai tuh thil hingte kha kisukha leh akiang ua kangtalai peite, zinling thawm bang nei ahi uhi.
Huchi in kha in hon domkang a, ahon lamangta a, heh mahmah leh ut lou pipi in ka kuanta hi; TOUPA khut lah ka tung ah ahat ngal a.
Huchi in Telabib a saltangte, Kebar lui a tengte kiang ka va tung a, atutna uah ka tu a; lamdang satak in huai ah ni sagih ka tuta hi.
Huchi in ni sagih abei in hichi ahong hi a, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Amite Vengtu Ding In TOUPA'N Ezekiel Asep / (Eze 33.1-9)

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote vilpa in nang ka hon sep hi; huchi in ka kam a thu na za ding a, kei sik in amaute vauna na pe ding hi."

Migilou kiang a ka thu, "Na si mahmah ding," ka chih a, huai migilou ahinna hum ding a agitlouhna lampi paisan ding a vauna na neih louh a, vauna thu leng na hilh sam louh a, huai migilou agitlouhna a asihleh asisan moh nang lak ah ka hon sik ngeingei ding hi.
Himahleh huai migilou na vau a, agitlouhna apaisan louh a, agitlouhna lampi alehngatsan sam keileh, agitlouhna ah asi ding a, nang bel na hinna na humbit ahi zaw ding hi.

"Huan midiktat in adiktatna lehngatsan a gitlouhna ahih a, ama a pukna ka koihleh, asi ding; vauna na neih louh ziak in akhelhna ah asi ding a; athil diktat ahihsate theihgige ahi kei ding; asisan moh ahihleh na lak ah ka hon sik ding hi.
Himahleh midiktat khial lou ding a na vauhilh a, akhelh keileh vauna akhawksak ziak in ahing ding; nang leng na hinna na humbit ding hi," achi hi.
Huan huai ah TOUPA khut ka tung ah a-om a, ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, phaizang ah pai inla, huai ah ka hon houpih ding," achi a. Huchi in ka thou a, phaizang ah ka paita hi.
heading: Ezekiel Apau Thei kei Ding

paite: Ngai in, huai ah TOUPA thupina, Kebar lui a ka muh thupina bang ahong dingh a, kei ka khuppukta hi.
Huchi in kei ah kha ahong lut a, ka khe in ahon dingsak a, ahon houpih a, "Pai inla, na inn ah kikhakkhum in.
Nang zaw, mihing tapa, khauhual in ahon khih ding ua, ahon gak ding ua, alak uah na pawtkhe nawn kei ding.
Na dangtawng ah na lei ka belhsak ding a, na pau nawn kei ding a, amaute salpa na hi nawn kei ding; helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua."

Himahleh na kiang a thu ka gen hun chiang in na kam ka hon ka sak ding a, akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Angaikhia in ngaikhia henla, angaikhe lou in ngaikhe kei hen, helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua, achi, " chi in na gen ding hi.
